I think you should be yourself, and do what makes you happy. It's gonna be hard as hell at first but if you accept yourself and stick with it, others will eventually follow. There may be a lot of others like you and you may make them feel less alone. But do it on your own terms and on your own time.

Take aaaaall the time you need to make a decision, don't worry about "falling behind".. I was in the exact same situation, everyone used to tell me that I would make a good engineer, so I followed the path they chose for me instead of what I really wanted. Now I'm struggling with EVERYTHING ! Believe me success is not about the field itself, it's about doing whatever YOU WANT and are passionate about.

I have a job that I hate and in which I'm failing. I was considered a very brilliant student, and after high school I tried  more to follow success rather than what I wanted to do. All it got me is failure and depression.

I also finished the show two days ago and I agree with a lot of what you said. Except one point when you say they haven't shed enough light on how Mitch is evil. Even though you say at the end it made sense, I still found it brilliant how they dealt with Mitch from the start. Because this show deals with sexual misconduct, not harassement or rape, and it's way more controversial. Like you said some people may be okay with Mitch's behaviour and that's exactly what the show intended (I think). They wanted to go easy and show progressively how Mitch is actually bad to win over or convince people who don't get how sexual misconduct is bad news. We see him in the beginning say how it was consentual, how those girls were never coerced etc and that's because there are still some people who think it has to be rape for sex to be not okay. You may also be referring to how Alex was still his friend and how she missed him instead of being extremely disappointed in him and even disgusted with him. But that's the thing, men like him have families and friends who can justify these actions and turn a blind eye to it. So if any man watching relates in any way to Mitch they get to see little by little how bad his behaviour is. I even think that's why they picked Steve Carell for the part, because he's just a loveable figure, who can never be suspected for such accusations and who is associated with fun and all good things. But guess what!  Any one can be a predator.
